meta.title: Nightfall Launcher — a fast, free Minecraft: Java Edition launcher
meta.desc: Nightfall is a free, ad-free Minecraft: Java Edition launcher for Windows and Linux with Modrinth and CurseForge built in, shared mod storage, share codes, an FPS doctor and crash help.
hero.tag: Free, no ads, for Windows and Linux
hero.title:
Play Minecraft.
Nothing in the way.
hero.lead: Nightfall is a calm launcher for Minecraft: Java Edition, built for max FPS. Modrinth and CurseForge built in, one copy of every mod on your disk, and share codes for your friends.
hero.smartscreen: Windows warning? Click More info, then Run anyway. The installer isn't code-signed yet.
hero.signin: Microsoft sign-in is built in and waiting on Mojang's approval.
feat.title: Everything you need, nothing you don't.
feat.sub: Built for players who want to press Play and have it just work, with the controls there when you want them.
feat.perf.d: A performance preset matched to your version (Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore and more), tuned Java flags, and the launcher pauses itself while you play.
feat.modrinth.d: Search mods, modpacks, shaders, resource packs and datapacks. Dependencies install themselves, and .mrpack and CurseForge .zip packs import.
feat.toggle.d: Press the N button on the title screen, switch mods on or off, then Apply & Restart. You're back in a few seconds.
feat.update.d: Install once. New versions download quietly in the background and install when you close the launcher.
feat.crash.d: 114 known crashes explained in plain words, with fixes in order. The crash checker also names the mod most likely to blame.
feat.simple.d: One big Play button and nothing else, for anyone who doesn't want menus. Advanced mode is one switch away.
feat.shared.d: Keybinds, controls and audio follow you across instances. FPS options like render distance stay with each pack, and any pack can keep its own settings.
feat.loaders.d: Vanilla, snapshots, Fabric, Quilt, Forge and NeoForge, plus old alpha and beta versions and LiteLoader, each with the right Java.
feat.access.d: High contrast, reduced motion, a dyslexia-friendly font, UI scaling and full keyboard navigation, in 23 languages.

faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.sub: Can't find yours? Ask on Discord. Game crashed? Try crash help first.
faq.a1: Yes. Nightfall is free, with no ads and no paid tiers. You still need to own Minecraft: Java Edition to play online.
faq.q2: Windows says "Windows protected your PC". Is it safe?
faq.a2: The installer isn't code-signed yet, so SmartScreen warns about every new app. Click More info, then Run anyway. Only download Nightfall from this website or the official GitHub releases.
faq.q3: Why can't I sign in with Microsoft yet?
faq.a3: Sign-in is built, but Minecraft's services only accept a new launcher after Mojang approves it. Everything works as soon as approval comes in.
faq.q4: Does it work on macOS or Linux?
faq.a4: Linux, yes: there's an AppImage (x86_64) on the download page, though Windows gets the most testing. There's no macOS build yet.
faq.a5: Nightfall checks when it starts and every few hours, downloads quietly and shows Update ready with a Restart button. On 0.1.0, install the latest version once by hand.
faq.a6: Yes. Fabric, Quilt, Forge and NeoForge all work, plus vanilla, snapshots, old alpha and beta versions and LiteLoader. OptiFine works on Forge.
faq.a7: Open crash help and paste your log, or use /crash in our Discord. Both match it against over 100 known crashes and tell you the fix.
faq.a8: No. Nightfall is an independent project. It isn't an official Minecraft product and isn't approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.
faq.a9: Almost nothing. Your sign-in happens on Microsoft's own page and tokens stay encrypted on your PC. See the privacy policy.

help.title: Crash help
help.sub: Known Minecraft: Java Edition crashes and launch errors, with fixes ranked by what works most often. The Nightfall launcher uses the same list to explain crashes automatically. Each error has its own link you can share.
help.privacy: Paste a crash report, a log or the error line. It is checked in your browser and never uploaded.
help.nomatch: No known match. Try the first line that says Exception or Error.
help.en: Error details are in English for now.
help.issue: Something missing or wrong? Open an issue on GitHub.
feat.storage.d: Every mod, resource pack and shader is stored once and linked into each instance that uses it. Ten packs with Sodium keep one copy.
feat.share.d: Turn an instance into an NF1 code or a QR code. A friend pastes it and gets the same version, loader and mods.
feat.import.d: Bring your instances over from Prism, MultiMC, CurseForge, the Modrinth App, ATLauncher, GDLauncher and more.
feat.linux.d: A Windows installer, plus an AppImage for Linux. Windows gets the most testing.

faq.q10: Will Nightfall give me more FPS?
faq.a10: Nightfall is built for max FPS: a performance preset, tuned Java flags, and the launcher pauses while you play. Your FPS still depends mostly on your PC, game settings and mods, so we don't promise a number. Run Performance check (Instance → Options) to see which graphics card and memory the game will use.
faq.q11: Who can see my emotes and Nightfall badge?
faq.a11: Only other Nightfall players, and only once the optional Nightfall online service launches. It's off by default and only shares your Minecraft player ID. Until then, emotes play just for you.
faq.q12: Can friends join my local server over the internet?
faq.a12: The local server is for your PC and home network (LAN). Friends outside your home can't join it without a server setup of your own.
